description: Adds optional "speaker" and "emotion" per scene, for cartoon-mode multi-character dialogue (dialogue_script_writer) where one scene is one spoken line, not a narration paragraph. Both fields are absent on a single-narrator script, which stays valid unchanged. MINOR bump per RFC 0007: purely additive, existing 1.0.0/1.1.0 artifacts stay valid, consumers on ^1 keep working.

point.description: What this beat does for the story.

speaker.description: character_id from the run's cast_roster who speaks this line. Absent for single-narrator scripts.

emotion.description: The speaker's emotional delivery for this line - drives the cartoon renderer's expression/pose choice. Only meaningful alongside "speaker".
